name: vintest-adapter
description: Discovers and runs VinTest game tests via the VS Code Testing panel

vintest.vsPath.description: Absolute path to the VintageStory installation directory to be passed to --vs-path Cake argument. Falls back to the VINTAGE_STORY environment variable, then to a <VINTAGE_STORY> property in any Directory.Build.props found in the workspace.

vintest.cakeBuildProject.description: Relative workspace path to the Cake .csproj (e.g. 'ZZCakeBuild/CakeBuild.csproj'). Auto-detected if empty.

vintest.configuration.description: Dotnet build configuration. Mirrors the --configuration Cake argument. IGNORED when debugging tests.

vintest.ignoreLogErrors.description: When true, captured log lines matching error patterns do *NOT* fail the build. Mirrors the --ignore-log-errors Cake argument.

vintest.cakeTarget.description: Name of the Cake target that drives gametests to invoke via --target.

vintest.dataPath.description: Relative workspace path to the VintageStory data directory (the folder containing Saves/, Logs/, TestResults/, etc.). Auto-detected as 'gamedata/' next to the Cake project if empty.
